chunks.title: Edit planner contract
chunks.content: The edit planner returns trimSeconds, speed, mute, filters, and labels. Filters must be valid ffmpeg syntax and safe to execute. Combine independent filters in the filters array. If a request is ambiguous, choose a conservative interpretation and describe it in labels.

chunks.title: Color grading reference
chunks.content: Cinematic: eq=contrast=1.18:saturation=1.05,vignette. Moody: eq=brightness=-0.06:contrast=1.15:saturation=0.85. Vibrant: eq=saturation=1.4:contrast=1.1. Warm: colorbalance=rs=0.12:gs=0.04:bs=-0.1. Cool: colorbalance=rs=-0.1:bs=0.12. Black and white: hue=s=0. Sepia: hue=s=0.4,colorbalance=rs=0.15:gs=0.05:bs=-0.15. Teal and orange: colorbalance=rs=0.1:gs=-0.05:bs=-0.1,eq=contrast=1.1.

chunks.title: Speed and time reference
chunks.content: Slow motion at half speed uses setpts=2*PTS and atempo=0.5. Two-times speed uses setpts=0.5*PTS and atempo=2.0. Trim the beginning of a clip with -t seconds or a trim filter. Keep audio tempo aligned when changing speed. Reverse video with reverse filter. Freeze frame with t=freeze.

chunks.title: Aspect ratio and framing
chunks.content: Vertical 9:16 uses crop=ih*9/16:ih. Horizontal 16:9 uses crop=ih*16/9:ih. Square uses crop=ih:ih. Zoom in with scale=iw*1.15:-1,crop=iw/1.15:ih/1.15. Zoom out can use scale=iw*0.9:-1,pad=iw*1.11:ih*1.11:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2. Letterbox with pad=ih*16/9:ih:(ow-iw)/2:0:black.

chunks.title: Audio reference
chunks.content: Mute audio with -an. Normalize dialogue or music with loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11. Increase volume with volume=1.5. Fade audio with afade=t=in:st=0:d=1,afade=t=out:st=duration-1:d=1. Remove silence only when the user asks for pause cleanup. Highpass filter for voice clarity: highpass=f=80. Lowpass for music: lowpass=f=8000.

chunks.title: Transitions and polish
chunks.content: A simple fade in and out uses fade=t=in:st=0:d=0.8,fade=t=out:st=2:d=0.8. Soft dreamy footage can use gblur=sigma=0.6,eq=saturation=1.05. Sharpen details with unsharp=5:5:0.7. Vintage film can use curves=vintage,noise=alls=8:allf=t. Glitch effect: rgbashift, noise. Chromatic aberration: lenscorrection.

chunks.title: Common edit workflows
chunks.content: Reels and TikTok usually benefit from 9:16 framing, vibrant color, and faster pacing. A cinematic cut usually uses letterboxing or a widescreen crop, restrained grading, and slower motion. A clean vlog keeps natural color, removes dead air, and uses steady pacing. A tutorial benefits from zooms on actions and clear audio. Podcast clips need captions, silence removal, and audio normalization.

chunks.title: Prompt interpretation examples
chunks.content: Make it cinematic with a slow fade in means a cinematic grade plus fade filters. Black and white, moody, trim to 10 seconds means hue=s=0, a moody grade, and a 10 second trim. Vibrant and punchy, speed it up 2x means higher saturation and contrast plus two-times speed. Vintage VHS look, muted audio means vintage filters and mute. Add animated captions means transcribe audio and burn word-by-word subtitles. Karaoke style captions means highlight each word as spoken. Remove pauses and add captions means auto-cut silence then transcribe.

chunks.title: Transcription with Whisper
chunks.content: Use OpenAI Whisper API for accurate speech-to-text. Supports 99+ languages. Returns segments with timestamps (start, end, text). Use verbose_json response format for word-level timestamps. Audio must be extracted first: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vn -acodec libmp3lame -ar 16000 -ac 1 audio.mp3. Maximum file size 25MB for direct API upload, longer files need chunking.

chunks.title: Animated caption styles
chunks.content: Default: Standard subtitles at bottom center. Karaoke: Each word highlights in sync with audio (yellow fill effect). Word-by-word: Single word appears at a time, centered. TikTok: Large bold font, yellow highlight, bounce animation, bottom safe zone. Cinematic: Elegant serif font, gold accent, subtle fade. Minimal: Clean sans-serif, no outline, lower third. All styles use ASS format for advanced positioning and effects.

chunks.title: Burning captions into video
chunks.content: Use ffmpeg subtitles filter to burn ASS/SRT into video: -vf "subtitles=caption.ass:force_style='Fontsize=52,Outline=3,Shadow=2'". For karaoke highlighting, ASS format with {\k} tags for each word. Word-by-word uses {\t} transform tags. Position with Alignment: 2=bottom center, 8=top center. MarginV for vertical offset. Use libx264 veryfast preset for speed.

chunks.title: SRT and ASS subtitle formats
chunks.content:
SRT: Simple format with index, timestamp range, text. Example: 1
00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:04,000
Hello world
. ASS: Advanced format with styles, positioning, karaoke tags. Supports {\k100} for karaoke timing (100 = 1 second in centiseconds). {	} for transformations. {\pos(x,y)} for positioning. { ad(in,out)} for fade. Use ASS for animated captions, SRT for simple subtitles.

chunks.title: Video editing best practices
chunks.content: Always normalize audio with loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 for consistent levels. Keep crf 20-23 for quality/size balance. Use -movflags +faststart for web streaming. Preserve original audio when possible. For vertical videos, blur background: gblur=sigma=20, crop=ih*9/16:ih, overlay. Add safe zones for captions: keep text within 80% width, 85% height from bottom. Test on mobile before publishing.
